message.content:
LeBron James is an American professional basketball player widely regarded as one of the greatest players in NBA history. He was born on December 30, 1984, in Akron, Ohio, and played high school basketball at St. Vincent‑St. Mary High School, where he gained national attention as a prodigy. After being selected first overall in the 2003 NBA Draft by the Cleveland Cavaliers, LeBron quickly became a dominant force in the league.

He has won four NBA championships (2012, 2013, 2016, 2020) with the Miami Heat, Cleveland Cavaliers, and Los Angeles Lakers, earning Finals MVP honors each time. LeBron has also earned numerous regular‑season accolades, including four NBA Most Valuable Player awards (2009, 2010, 2012, 2013). He has been selected to the All‑NBA First Team 13 times and has made the NBA All‑Star Game 19 times, winning the All‑Star MVP award twice.

Beyond his on‑court achievements, LeBron is known for his philanthropy, notably through the LeBron James Family Foundation, which opened the “I Promise” school in Akron to support at-risk youth. He has also pursued acting and business ventures, producing films and television shows and investing in various companies.
